object.attr: The whole route has to be visible without manual panning. The code fits the map to any non-empty list of location fixes, but the call may fail for exactly 1 location fix, so the status stays Proposed until that case is checked. Basis: both.
object.description: When the app displays a map of at least 1 location fix, the app shall position the map camera so that the visible map area contains the bounding box of the location fixes.
